# `gcp.interconnect`

Represents an Interconnect resource. The Interconnect resource is a dedicated connection between Google's network and your on-premises network.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/Interconnect` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: post_create (post_create/labels.tmpl) calls setLabels after the insert. magic-modules names setLabels as the labels field's update_url, so it is a setter here and a create whose read-back lacks the labels calls it (gcprov.setAfterCreate). Note what this type is: creating one orders a physical dedicated interconnect.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
